rules.name: Immortal Denizens
rules.description: Casting rolls made by models in a Daemon Legions army with one or two dice gain a +1 Casting Modifier. In addition, each player adds +2 Veil Tokens to their Veil Token pool in the Magic Phase during Siphon the Veil, when they are the Active Player.

rules.name: Divine Right
rules.description: The model cannot join units with other Characters and other Characters cannot join its unit. The model must issue a Duel whenever possible. Duels issued by this model must (if possible) be accepted by a Character unless a Champion accepts first. In addition, when fighting a Duel, the model gains Lethal Strike and Multiple Wounds (2).

rules.name: Rising Star
rules.description: Each time the model kills an enemy model in a Duel, the model gains a +1 Combat Score modifier for the rest of the game.

rules.name: Omniscience
rules.description: In the Magic Phase, if the model did not March Move or declare a Charge this Player Turn, the cost of converting Veil Tokens into Magic Dice is decreased to 2:1 during this Player Turn (1 Magic Die per 2 Veil Tokens). In addition, at the end of Siphon the Veil, the owner is allowed to store up to 6 Veil Tokens instead of the normal 3.

rules.name: Devour
rules.description: For each unsaved wound the model causes with Close Combat Attacks against enemy units, roll a D6 at the end of the Initiative Step. For each rolled 4+, the model gains +1 Health Point. When the model has 18 Health Points, all units within 9" immediately suffer 2D6 hits with Toxic Attacks, and the model is removed as a casualty.

rules.name: Avert your Gaze
rules.description: Enemy units within 6″ of one or more models with Avert Your Gaze suffer −2 Discipline when taking Combat Reform tests.

rules.name: Razor Tentacles
rules.description:
Attack Attribute – Close Combat.
The model gains +3 Attack Value while Engaged with one or more Flank or Rear Facings of enemy units. The additional attacks must be allocated towards R&F models in these units. Ignore this effect if the model cannot allocate any Close Combat Attacks towards R&F models.

characteristics.name: Rules
characteristics.$text: For each Veil Token in the owner’s Veil Token pool, attacks against the wearer suffer −1 Armour Penetration, up to a maximum of 3.

rules.name: Tightening Grasp
rules.description: The model gains Grind Attacks (X), and can make Grind Attacks as Supporting Attacks. When the model is not Engaged in Combat, X is set to 1. At the end of each Round of Combat of a combat the model was Engaged in, X is increased by +1 (e.g. Grind Attacks (1) becomes Grind Attacks (2)).

rules.name: Falling Star
rules.description: The model’s Offensive Skill and Defensive Skill are set to twice the model’s current number of Health Points.

characteristics.name: Attributes
characteristics.$text: Volley Gun Artillery Weapon. Before rolling for the number of shots, the owner may choose to discard 1–3 Veil Tokens from its Veil token pool. If so, the number of shots is increased by +3 per discarded Veil Token.

rules.name: Engine of Damnation
rules.description: The model’s base is changed to 150×100 mm and its Height to Gigantic. Its Health Points are set to 8 and it loses War Platform.
